English: Spindle Patch
A rough clearing set aside for nomads to gather and spin raw fibers into thread, vital for clothing and repairs.
Weavers Tent
A sturdy, portable tent where skilled clan members weave simple fabrics, improving population comfort and supply.
Loom Hut
A semi-permanent hut for larger looms, enabling more complex textiles and increasing the clans ability to support a growing horde.
Dye Pavilion
A canopy dedicated to dyeing fabrics with local plants and minerals, producing distinctive clan colors and attracting skilled weavers.
Patterned Room
A decorated, semi-permanent structure for weaving intricate patterns, symbolizing clan prestige and improving unity.
Textile Chamber
A large, impressive hall where master weavers oversee the production of fine textiles, drawing traders and boosting population capacity.
Market Weaver Hall
A bustling hub where textiles are bartered, attracting merchants and increasing the clans wealth and supply.
Guild Pavilion
A grand tent where the most skilled weavers form a guild, training apprentices and boosting both manpower and clan prestige.
Master Weavers Room
An ornate, semi-permanent chamber for the master of the weaving guild, symbolizing clan unity and attracting the finest artisans.
East African Weaving Guild
A legendary weaving complex, famed throughout the region, bringing immense prosperity, unity, and renown to the clan.
